steps.message: The current bug is the `current ||= snapshot` fallback: after the provider returns, a withdrawn/deleted/reassigned document can still cause an embedding to be written. The fix will keep the provider call outside all transactions, perform a locked authoritative recheck inside the storage transaction, discard on any mismatch, and make same-document/version writes revision-aware so an older result cannot replace a newer embedding. I’ll implement this and add regression coverage without touching protected files.

module Knowledge
  class EmbeddingJob
    def call(document_id:, tenant_id:, version:, provider:)
      snapshot = Document.find_by(id: document_id, tenant_id: tenant_id, published: true)
      return :discarded unless snapshot

      vector = provider.call(snapshot.body)

        elsif embedding.revision <= current.revision
          embedding.update!(tenant_id: tenant_id, revision: current.revision, vector: JSON.generate(vector))
        end
      end
      :stored
    end
  end
end
